retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle heroic portrait of a man in Western attire set against a dramatic, overcast sky and a grassy foreground.
triggerTerms: stormy sky background with prairie grass

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body, low-angle shot of a man wearing a black cowboy hat, light-colored button-down shirt, and dark jeans with a large belt buckle. He stands in a field of tall grass and wildflowers under a heavy, blue-grey cloud-filled sky. The composition features bold serif text at the top and lowercase spaced-out text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject towers over the horizon line to create a sense of scale and importance.
The dark blue-grey sky provides a high-contrast backdrop for the light-colored shirt.
Foreground grass overlaps the subject's lower legs to ground him in the environment.
Typography frames the subject at the extreme top and bottom margins.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally located, full-body figure occupying the vertical center, scaled to appear monumental.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and black cowboy hat against the lighter clouds.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down the subject's body to the bottom text, then back up to the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The expansive sky on either side of the subject provides breathing room for the large-scale figure.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the shirt and the dark sky/hat.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic Roman serif and modern geometric serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Tall, condensed serif with sharp terminals and high stroke contrast.
Bottom text: Lowercase, wide-tracked, monolinear serif with rounded terminals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Drop shadows applied to top text for legibility against clouds.
Extreme letter-spacing (tracking) for the bottom text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, condensed uppercase header and a light, airy lowercase footer.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the traditional, authoritative feel of the top header.
Provides the slab-serif structure for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a man in a black cowboy hat, light blue shirt, and jeans standing in a field of grass under a dark, moody, overcast sky. Ensure the horizon is low in the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large condensed serif uppercase text at the very top with a soft drop shadow. Add lowercase slab-serif text with wide tracking across the bottom third, positioned over the grass.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle sufficiently low to make the subject look heroic?
Is the top text condensed and uppercase?
Is the bottom text lowercase with significant spacing between letters?

adjustableVariables: Subject's pose (looking at camera vs. looking away)
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
Exact facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Sky has visible cloud texture and depth.
Typography does not obscure the subject's face.
Color palette remains muted and cohesive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Heroic Low-Angle Portrait + Moody Sky + Dual-Tier Serif Typography
